name: 28732 · Fletcher, NC
findings: ZIP 28732 (Fletcher) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28732 (Fletcher) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28732 (Fletcher) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
